[[Giant Needle Spider]]s are spiders found in [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]. They always [[Popup|drop out of trees to ambush]] players, often in clusters of 2 or 3.

They can sometimes be found near a stationary [[Giant Tree Spider]].

It is revealed during the quest [[The Orchard]] that they are attracted to the scent of apples, leading some of them to invade [[Mary Malone]]'s [[Apple orchard]].
